mapper.insert: insert into structure_table (note_id, project_id, side, note_no, table_title, table_order, source_locator, created_at, updated_at) values (#{noteId}, #{projectId}, #{side}, #{noteNo}, #{tableTitle}, #{tableOrder}, #{sourceLocator}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.delete: delete from structure_table where project_id = #{projectId} and side = #{side}
delete from structure_table where project_id = #{projectId} and side = #{side} and note_no = #{noteNo}
